$ /bin/bash -c source /logs/agent/sessions/shell-snapshots/snapshot-bash-1794706093281-lqxnat.sh 2>/dev/null || true && \builtin s
hopt -u extglob 2>/dev/null || true && { \builtin unalias -- 'which'; \builtin unset -f -- 'which'; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && {
\builtin unalias -- 'unsetenv'; \builtin unset -f -- 'unsetenv'; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && eval 'cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_
TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; N="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $N cloud projects --help 2>&1 | sed -n 1,40p; $N cloud projects servers --hel
p 2>&1 | head -30' < /dev/null && pwd -P >| /tmp/claude-ee7d-cwd
Usage: mcpjam cloud projects [options] [command]
Operate the MCP servers saved in your hosted MCPJam projects
Options:
-h, --help display help for command
Commands:
list [options] List the projects you can access
create [options] Create a hosted MCPJam project
update [options] Update project metadata
delete [options] Delete a project and its project-owned resources
capabilities [options] Show what you may do in a project: your role, which
betas the organization has, your plan's limits, and a
can-block of booleans. Ask this before scripting
anything that authors, launches or publishes.
servers [options] List and manage the servers saved in a project
status [options] Health-check every server in a project (hosted doctor
per server)
help [command] display help for command
Usage: mcpjam cloud projects servers [options] [command]
List and manage the servers saved in a project
Options:
--project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently
updated project)
-h, --help display help for command
Commands:
create|add [options] Create a saved MCP server
get [options] Get one saved MCP server
revisions [options] List a saved server's stored revisions, newest
first: captures of its tools and server info
revision [options] Read one stored revision of a saved server: its
tools and server info
revision-diff [options] Compare two stored revisions of a saved server:
tools added, removed and changed, and server info
changes
update [options] Update one saved MCP server
delete|remove [options] Delete one saved MCP server
connect [options] Connect an MCP server URL to a project, authorizing
in a browser if needed
connect-status [options] Check a connection request started by `server
connect`
connect-cancel [options] Cancel a pending connection request started by
`server connect`
[exit=0; signal=None; timeout=unrecorded]
